summary: Classification of loan accounts as fraud under RBI Master Directions; natural justice, especially audi alteram partem, must be read into the process due to serious civil consequences; no prior notice or hearing violates fairness; impugned classification quashed where principles of natural justice were bypassed; High Court directions partially stayed pending appeal; classification not invalidated per se but procedural fairness mandated; borrowers entitled to pre-decisional hearing and copy of forensic audit report.
legal_provisions_cited: Reserve Bank of India (Frauds Classification and Reporting by Commercial Banks and Select FIs) Directions 2016
final_judgment: Appeals allowed in part; requirement of audi alteram partem read into Master Directions; classification of accounts as fraud must follow principles of natural justice; borrowers to be given opportunity of hearing and copy of forensic audit report before final decision.
